name: Harpd Evidence Graph
description: Every published Harpd claim resolved to its evidence, dataset, methodology, source and data timestamp. Claims that fail the chain are listed with the reason instead of being removed.

MEASURED.label: Measured
MEASURED.note: Produced by a recorded Harpd run against a published task and success definition.

OBSERVED.label: Observed
OBSERVED.note: Read directly out of a first-party Harpd record at a recorded time.

CALCULATED.label: Calculated
CALCULATED.note: Derived arithmetically from a published dataset; the calculation is stated in the methodology.

MODELED.label: Modeled estimate
MODELED.note: An estimate, not a measurement. Must be labelled "estimated" wherever it appears.

EDITORIAL.label: Editorial
EDITORIAL.note: Harpd framing or opinion. Never presented as an independent measurement.

USER_SUBMITTED.label: User submitted
USER_SUBMITTED.note: Supplied by the product owner or a visitor. Must be attributed to its submitter.

datasets.name: Harpd Product Ranking Dataset
datasets.description: One record per approved product on Harpd Rank: rank position, Rank Points (promotional placement), category, verification state and per-record updatedAt.
datasets.updateFrequency: Continuous — regenerated from live Rank data on request.
datasets.coverage: All approved Harpd Rank listings across all categories.

datasets.name: Harpd Historical Ranking Dataset
datasets.description: Immutable closed-period snapshots of Harpd Rank, used to derive movement, new entrants and category shifts in research reports.
datasets.updateFrequency: Monthly — a period is written once, after it closes, and never edited.
datasets.coverage: Closed monthly snapshots of the ranking board.

datasets.name: Harpd Product Directory Dataset
datasets.description: Product entities in the Harpd dataset: name, slug, category, capabilities, verification state, profile URL.

datasets.name: Harpd Category Dataset
datasets.description: Harpd categories with product counts and board URLs.

datasets.name: Harpd Rank Open Data (non-sponsored signals)
datasets.description: Deliberately excludes Rank Points and ranking position. Publishes only signals that cannot be bought: verification state, listing age, first-party referred visits, declared repository stars.
datasets.updateFrequency: Daily refresh of declared repository stars; other fields continuous.

datasets.name: Harpd Model Pricing Dataset
datasets.description: One record per model with input/output token price, the official provider pricing page it was read from, and the date it was verified.
datasets.updateFrequency: Re-verified against official provider pages; each record carries its own verification date.
datasets.coverage: Public list prices for the models Harpd tools cost out.

datasets.name: Harpd Benchmark Dataset
datasets.description: Long-format benchmark records (model, task, metric, score, cost, timestamp) with an explicit isModeled flag separating measured runs from modeled estimates.
datasets.updateFrequency: Per benchmark run. Historical runs are never overwritten.
datasets.coverage: Published benchmark tasks; measured and modeled records are flagged separately.

datasets.name: Harpd Research Dataset
datasets.description: One record per published monthly research report: research family, the closed UTC month it covers, the report URL and the number of ranked products in scope. Every figure inside a report is derived from that month's closed rank snapshot; nothing is authored by hand.
datasets.updateFrequency: Monthly: a report is generated once its UTC month has closed and is never rewritten.
datasets.coverage: Published Harpd Research reports across all research families.

datasets.name: Harpd Methodology Dataset
datasets.description: Machine-readable export of the Harpd Rank rules, boards, entry conditions and disclosure.
datasets.updateFrequency: On rule change, with the change recorded on /changelog/.

rules: A claim is publishable only when it resolves to a registered dataset, a methodology URL and a real data timestamp.
MODELED claims must be labelled as estimates wherever they appear and are never presented as measured results.
EDITORIAL and USER_SUBMITTED claims never appear on a fact surface; user-submitted content must be attributed.
Harpd Rank Points are promotional placement, not an editorial quality score, and may not be described with editorial-quality wording.
Nothing here is back-filled: a missing dataset or timestamp produces a violation, not a default value.

notClaimed.statement: That any model is "safe to switch to" for a production workload.
notClaimed.why: A switch decision requires a real-task quality gate on the specific workload. No dataset covers that yet.
notClaimed.note: We publish the method, not a result.

notClaimed.statement: That a higher-ranked product on Harpd Rank is a better product.
notClaimed.why: Rank Points are promotional placement bought with Credits. Harpd holds no quality measurement that would support an ordering by merit.

notClaimed.statement: Monthly visit counts or user review scores for listed products.
notClaimed.why: Harpd has no first-party measurement of third-party traffic or reviews, and does not republish vendor-supplied figures as facts.
notClaimed.note: The non-sponsored signals Harpd can verify are published in /data/rank-open-data.json instead.
